source_row.rationale: Tramadol labeling warns that serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening, has occurred particularly with concomitant serotonergic drugs including SSRIs. Clinical monitoring and medication review are warranted.
source_row.source_detail: Warnings and Precautions, Serotonin Syndrome Risk: concomitant serotonergic drugs including SSRIs; current label accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: A client taking an SSRI is prescribed tramadol. Which medication-safety concern should the nurse recognize?
